claims_that_could_not_be_verified: True physical byte offsets, original encodings, raw on-disk byte counts, or identity across symlinks/hardlinks/renames.
Historical Git repository roots for targets that no longer resolve to an extant current .git ancestor.
Actual simultaneous execution rather than co-activity within the same UTC minute.
Explicit session close times or uncensored last-write-to-close claim linger.
Files actually read or written by shell subprocesses, scripts, git, package managers, formatters, code generators, variables, or glob expansion.
Reads through Grep/search, prompts, shared context, or other non-Read tools.
That a first read caused a later write or that a claim had to remain live throughout the measured interval.
Binary workload completeness when tools refused or omitted binary payloads.
Event-log byte retention or byte bandwidth before the final serialized event schema is benchmarked.
Sub-minute peak throughput or operation-overlap durations.
The earlier approximate 5:1 shell dominance: this freeze measures 3.292:1 after deduplication and 3.012:1 over raw copied-record occurrences.
The earlier 99.6% Read and 98.7% Edit/Write metadata figures as corpus-wide usable-metadata coverage; source-specific result shapes differ materially.
Generalization beyond this one team, Claude Code harness, compatible-goal history, and Node-dominated workload.

capture_coverage.measurement_confidence: Moderate-low for recovered shell paths; High for channel counts
capture_coverage.reason: Shell/tool counts are exact after quarantine; lexical path recovery is conditioned on a 50-command manual audit and does not prove effects.

corpus_freeze.reason: Sorted byte lengths were fixed before reads; exact prefixes and per-file/global SHA-256 values are recorded, with read/truncation/growth diagnostics.

edit_region_sizes.measurement_confidence: High in exact-preimage slice; Moderate for byte interpretation
edit_region_sizes.reason: Patches parse and old blocks validate against same-result originalFile; most successful subagent writes lack this evidence.

event_volume.measurement_confidence: High for paired structured events; low as total file activity
event_volume.reason: Direct timestamps and exact active-hour denominators, but shell and non-Read channels are not typed file events.

file_type_mix.reason: Mutually exclusive extension/basename rules are deterministic; binary means binary-looking path, not inspected content.

index_cardinality.reason: First-seen files/pairs and zero-growth ISO weeks are deterministic; completeness is limited by missing structured paths and aliases.

observed_concurrency.measurement_confidence: High for minute buckets; Moderate-low for true overlap/repository grouping
observed_concurrency.reason: Actor sets are deterministic for conflict-free post-quarantine calls; excluded ambiguous IDs may move tails. Same-minute activity is not duration overlap and historical Git-root attribution is incomplete.

read_multiplicity.measurement_confidence: High for localized lexical paths; Moderate as total reader fan-out
read_multiplicity.reason: Rolling/calendar windows and identities are deterministic, but shell/search exposures are omitted and aliases are unresolved.

read_to_write_intervals.reason: Endpoints are observed, but causality is unproven, many operations lack paths, and observed end is a censored last record rather than close.

read_window_sizes.measurement_confidence: High for lines; Moderate for bytes
read_window_sizes.reason: Result startLine/numLines are direct; UTF-8 payload bytes are re-encoded transcript text, not disk bytes. Subagent metadata is absent.

session_lengths.measurement_confidence: High as observed timestamp span; Low as launch-to-close lifetime
session_lengths.reason: Spans and kept-call counts are direct after identity reconciliation and quarantine, but excluded ambiguous IDs may move call tails, idle gaps remain, and no close/crash marker exists.

universal_defaults.reason: Only one team, harness, and Node-dominated workload was measured.

corpus.path_rule: result metadata only for structured operations; best-effort parsed command paths reported separately
corpus.repository_proxy_rule: first directory below .claude/projects (Claude project bucket), not a verified VCS root
corpus.snapshot_rule: reuse an existing path-redacted manifest by ordered prefix-hash mapping, then read exactly its recorded byte prefixes

global_tool_id_group_quarantine.interpretation: counts and distributions are conditional on the kept, conflict-free tool-ID groups

capture_coverage.intent_description: regex heuristic: read, write, read_write, or ambiguous; intent is not filesystem-effect proof
capture_coverage.parser_description: quote-aware token scan; absolute/UNC, explicit relative, path-flag, common-basename, and known-extension candidates; resolves literals against recorded cwd; retains home/environment aliases as unresolved symbolic mentions; excludes URLs, switches, unresolved variables, and globs from canonical-file counts

raw_channel_occurrences.note: occurrences include copied transcript records; deduplicated conflict-quarantined ratio is primary

shell_parser_hand_validation.interpretation: Recovery validates lexical path mentions, not successful I/O or read/write effects. Ambiguous references are excluded from recall; commands were disproportionately stratified.

population_weighted_estimates.method: inverse-stratum sampling weights; point estimates only because path mentions cluster within commands

shell_parser_hand_validation.selection_rule: deterministic disproportionate strata: Bash parser-positive 20, Bash negative 10, PowerShell positive 10, PowerShell negative 10; lowest frozen-corpus-seeded SHA-256 ranks

edit_region_sizes.claim_definition: per contiguous +/- change block max(removed, added); pure insertions are zero-width on the old side but claim their added span; byte proxy is LF-normalized UTF-8 max(old,new)
edit_region_sizes.exact_byte_definition: raw hunk old-side byte span reconstructed from the same originalFile string with its observed separators; transcript Unicode, not verified disk encoding

global_tool_id_group_quarantine.interpretation: counts and distributions are conditional on the kept, conflict-free tool-ID groups

file_type_mix.classification_rule: mutually exclusive path-extension/basename classifier; binary means binary-looking extension, not inspected content

index_cardinality.growth_time_span_definition: every ISO week from the first to last timestamped logical-actor record in the frozen corpus, including leading, trailing, and internal zero-growth weeks

global_tool_id_group_quarantine.interpretation: counts and distributions are conditional on the kept, conflict-free tool-ID groups

observed_concurrency.primary_identity: logical actor: agentId when present, otherwise sessionId
observed_concurrency.repository_scope: primary same-repository slice resolves each structured target to an extant current .git ancestor; historical/deleted targets are unknown. Claude project directory results are a separately labeled proxy

read_to_write_intervals.censoring: no explicit close marker; live, paused, or crashed sessions are right-censored at the frozen last record
read_to_write_intervals.session_end_definition: last timestamped record for the logical actor in the frozen corpus prefix

read_window_sizes.byte_definition: UTF-8 byte length of every same-result toolUseResult.file.content string; metadata line-count agreement is diagnostic only, not an eligibility gate; not on-disk encoding or line-ending bytes

global_tool_id_group_quarantine.interpretation: counts and distributions are conditional on the kept, conflict-free tool-ID groups

session_lengths.wall_clock_definition: first to last timestamped record for the logical actor in the frozen prefix; idle gaps remain included

item_5_read_write_intervals.warning: shell intent is heuristic and cannot be treated as observed read/write truth

item_6_concurrency.note: structured-plus-shell minute counts isolate the observed shell timestamp channel but still miss non-tool thinking time and do not prove duration overlap

paired_actor_count_delta_on_structured_p.support: structured-plus-shell active minute/repository-minute cells; structured count is zero where absent

percentile_rule: nearest-rank over the explicitly named population; max is observed maximum

event_log.retention_bytes_reason: final event serialization has not been benchmarked

recommended_seeds.interpretation: Observed percentile seeds for @perrepo startup; recalibrate online and retain observed maxima as diagnostics, not universal hard limits.

lease_proxy.seed_derivation: one hour, rounded from the observed p90 first-read-to-absolute-first-write interval
lease_proxy.warning: long/censored tails require renewal and explicit close; do not install the linger percentile as an unattended lease

one_shot_dispatch.warning: observed wall clock includes idle gaps and is not a dispatch timeout or close boundary

scope.use: self-calibrating @perrepo seed defaults, not universal constants
scope.workload: one team, one Claude Code harness, Node-dominated

what_would_change_this_verdict: Persist normalized repository/worktree IDs, real file IDs, encodings, raw byte ranges, and before/after hashes on every file operation.
Emit structured shell/subprocess effects with expanded paths, read/write direction, success, and byte intervals.
Emit explicit session start, heartbeat, close, and crash events plus operation start/end intervals.
Capture result-side path/range/patch/pre-image metadata uniformly in main, direct-subagent, and workflow-subagent transcripts.
Serialize and benchmark the finalized event record to convert event-count retention into bytes and sustained write bandwidth.
Validate the shell parser on a larger independently reviewed sample, especially opaque inline-code, heredoc/here-string, variable, and glob cases.
Replicate across teams, harnesses, languages, repository sizes, and intentionally adversarial workloads.
